findings.text: The changed reason "the checker could not reconstruct this computed schema" has no test, and the test of the old reason was removed, although the task file's acceptance requires a negative case whose diagnostic is checked. Fix: add a fixture whose computed schema has a value with no SQL spelling, and assert the new reason in `tests/surface_check_run_schemas_test.py` or a nearby surface test.

The new modules ReplaySyntaxExpr, ReplayViewSql, ReplayTriggerSql, ReplayFunctionNames, ReplayResolvedExpr and ReplayTableSql have no module docstring (`/-! ... -/`) that says why each one exists. Fix: add a short module docstring to each file that says which catalog part it prints, and that replay validates the result.

The match over `Resolved.ScalarFunction` that chooses the arguments that get a collation ends in a catch-all `| _, rest => rest`. A new function that carries a collation would then lose it silently instead of causing a compile error. Fix: list each `ScalarFunction` constructor, or use a separate exhaustive function that returns the stored collation of a scalar function.
